name: 01-hook
headline: Stop doomscrolling.
Earn your screen time.
subline: Blocked apps stay locked until you move.
subline_es: Tus apps siguen bloqueadas hasta que te mueves.

name: 03-walk
headline: Every walk
earns you time.
subline_es: Caminar te da tiempo de pantalla.

name: 04-exercises
headline: No time to walk?
Squat it out.
subline: Push-ups, squats, lunges or jumping jacks.
subline_es: Flexiones, sentadillas, zancadas o jumping jacks.

name: 07-schedule
headline: Block when
it matters.
subline: Set the hours. Turn on strict mode.
subline_es: Elige las horas. Activa el modo estricto.

name: 08-outcome
headline: Win back
your evenings.
subline: Every minute you took back, counted.

name: 09-friends
headline: Keep each other
honest.
subline_es: Comparte rachas. Reta a un amigo.

name: 10-privacy
headline: Private
by design.
subline: Counted on your iPhone. Never uploaded.
subline_es: Se cuenta en tu iPhone. Nunca se sube.
